name: Lola McVey
role: CPA, CGFM, Director of Accounting and Finance, Bristol Tennessee Essential Services
bio: Lola McVey is the Director of Accounting & Finance at Bristol Tennessee Essential Services (BTES). She holds a bachelor degree in Business and Economics, is a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) and a Certified Government Financial Manager (CGFM). Lola served two terms as President of the Board and past Campaign Chair of the United Way of Bristol, is Treasurer of The Salvation Army of Bristol Advisory Board and serves on the Board of Directors of Bristol Regional Medical Center. She has previously served on the Tennessee Center for Performance Excellence board of examiners.
